Team — attaching a draft pricing matrix and a short rollout doc that maps to the tiers Alex requested.

Key points:
- Pilot tier: 200k tokens/month per project, shared burst up to 15 rps, no reserved capacity; suitable for Pulse MVP.
- Production Standard: 1.5M tokens/month per project, reserved throughput 60 rps, soft SLA for latency, monthly billing.
- Production HA: 5M tokens/month, reserved throughput 150 rps with SLA and optional Active-Active in two regions (add-on).

We can convert any tier to annual billing with a 10% prepay discount and a 12-month minimum term. If MetroHealth wants the contract amendment to move Pulse to annual billing starting on go-live, we can reflect that in the DocuSign-ready amendment.

Proposed rollout schedule (high level):
- Week 1 (Pilot prep): keying, prefix caching rules, test deck validation
- Week 2 (Pilot run): 2-week pilot window, telemetry collection, quality sign-off
- Week 4 (Prod cutover for Pulse): production keys issued, routing to dedicated pool if selected

Attachment: metrohealth_expansion_pricing.xlsx (xlsx)

Let me know what to put in the SOW annex and I’ll generate a minimal one for procurement review.

-Ben
